subject: Dallas to KC dry grocery - Mon 11/16
body:
Hi,

We bought a closeout lot of canned goods and boxed dry grocery that's sitting at Big-Box DC135 in Dallas. Need it brought up to our KC warehouse.

Pickup: Big-Box DC135, Dallas TX - Monday 11/16
Deliver: Midway Distributors KC Warehouse, Kansas City MO
20 pallets, about 31,000 lbs, dry (no reefer needed)
It's FOOD so the trailer has to be food grade / clean - no chem loads before it please.

Our PO is MD-55190.

Thanks!
Chip Delgado
Midway Distributors
